nobox.final_span:
wholehearted living.
With which single word would you describe the city of Manitowoc? Good.
What is it that you loved most about growing up or living in this area? Being a part of an amazing community that is safe and family-oriented is something I love.
Describe what you do with the island you just inherited from your uncle. I would establish an organic farm and lead a sustainable lifestyle. Recently, I visited my uncle's organic farm in Green Lake County and felt greatly inspired. I am initiating my small micro-farm in my backyard — and I am thrilled to pursue making it more "self-sustainable."
What would you tell the rest of the world about Manitowoc County? There are so many amazing individuals here along with a great sense of community spirit. Individuals truly care for each other.
And last but not least…
